annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes Mirror Trading International as a way to earn weekly trading profits and directs viewers to open and fund a broker account through a special registration link. It describes a $200 minimum deposit, recruitment-based earning levels, and a 10% Bitcoin-deposit referral bonus while claiming members receive 40% of trading profits weekly. The pitch also asserts broker affiliation, fund safety, and daily reporting, although no actual trades, payments, or realized earnings are shown.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central offer is participation in managed forex and commodity trading linked to recurring weekly profits. The video describes members funding trading accounts and receiving a stated share of trading profits, which supports an investment-return mechanism. A binary recruitment compensation structure is also explicitly presented as a secondary mechanism.
